title: 核心数据模型与契约
markdown:
以下为系统的核心承重数据模型：包含 SQLite 持久化数据表（位于 `episodic_memory.db`）以及部门与人员的 Pydantic 规范契约。

### 情景与调度数据表

| 数据表 | 核心字段说明 |
|---|---|
| `decisions` | `id`, `timestamp`, `domain`, `summary`, `rationale`, `outcome`, `tags`, `department`, `session_id` |
| `initiatives` | `id`, `title`, `status`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `summary`, `department` |
| `advice_given` | `id`, `timestamp`, `domain`, `query_summary`, `advice_summary`, `department`, `session_id` |
| `scheduled_actions` | `id`, `created_at`, `run_at`, `channel`, `channel_ref`, `intent_text`, `status`, `attempts`, `kind`, `department`, `assigned_to_person_id`, `awaiting_response_since`, `scope_key`, `required_scope` |
| `outbound_context` | `id`, `created_at`, `channel`, `channel_ref`, `recipient_person_id`, `outbound_text`, `originating_session_id`, `outbound_message_id`, `consumed_at`, `status` |
| `dynamic_workflows` | `name` (主键), `definition` (JSON), `is_active`, `created_at`, `updated_at` |

`department` 与 `session_id` 支持按需过滤；`session_id` 用于隔离不同通讯子线程的历史记忆。`scheduled_actions.status` 包含 pending / running / done / failed / cancelled。`dynamic_workflows` 用于持久化用户通过界面或对话自定义创建的多步骤工作流定义，包含动态参数输入字段与有序步骤清单。

### 人才寻访数据表

| 数据表 | 核心字段说明 |
|---|---|
| `engagements` | `id`, `role_title`, `department` (文本标签), `status`, `location`, `comp_band`, `must_haves`, `description`, `archived` |
| `candidates` | `id`, `engagement_id` (外键), `full_name`, `current_title`, `current_company`, `email`, `linkedin_url`, `source`, `stage`, `fit_score`, `screening_summary`, `notes`, `archived` |
| `offers` | `id`, `candidate_id` (外键), `engagement_id` (外键), `status`, `comp_summary`, `package_md`, `note`, `expires_at`, `extended_at`, `decided_at`, `approval_run_id`, `approved_by_person_id`, `nudge_action_ids_json`, `archived` |

`candidates.stage` 包含 lead / screened / interviewed / offer / placed / rejected。`offers.status` 由状态机严密约束：draft → pending_approval → extended → accepted / declined / expired / rescinded；每个候选人同一时刻最多存在一份有效 Offer。

`outbound_context` 将向外发出的私信关联回最初触发它的源头会话，使得收件人在 72 小时内回复时能够自动串联上文背景。

### 部门 / 目标 / 检查项模型

| 模型类 | 字段定义 |
|---|---|
| `DepartmentConfig` | `slug`, `title`, `specialist_key`, `charter`, `authority_level`, `head_person_id`, `head_persona_slug`, `cadences`, `slack_channel_id`, `discord_channel_id`, `telegram_chat_id` |
| `Goal` | `id`, `department_slug`, `period_type`, `period_value`, `key_result`, `target`, `current`, `status`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `last_reviewed_at` |
| `DepartmentState` | `config`, `goals`, `headcount`, `budget_usd`, `member_person_ids`, `updated_at` |

`authority_level` 包含 `auto_execute`（自主行动）、`propose_only`（提请审批）和 `escalate`（升级呈报）；目标状态包含 `on_track`、`at_risk`、`off_track`。

### 组织成员 (Person)

| 分组 | 字段列表 |
|---|---|
| 身份标识 | `id`, `full_name`, `role`, `is_principal`, `department_slugs` |
| 联系方式 | `email`, `slack_user_id`, `telegram_chat_id`, `discord_user_id`, `preferred_channel` |
| 路由与权限 | `availability`, `authority_scope`, `response_sla_hours`, `on_leave_until`, `reports_to_person_id` |
| 生命周期 | `archived`, `created_at`, `updated_at` |

名册中必须且只能有一位成员被标记为 `is_principal=True`，作为无法找到授权受托人时的最终决策责任人。
